Class SpecialPro

java.lang.Object
de.lmu.dbs.ifi.sep25.card.Card
de.lmu.dbs.ifi.sep25.card.ProgrammingCard.ProgrammingCard
de.lmu.dbs.ifi.sep25.card.ProgrammingCard.SpecialPro
All Implemented Interfaces:
RegisterCard, Cloneable
public class SpecialPro extends ProgrammingCard
A specialized programming card that performs unique routines such as energy gain, speed boost, sandbox choices, weasel turns, and damage mitigation.

The effect is determined by the specialEffect keyword.

    • execute

      public void execute(Robot robot, Player player)
      Executes the special routine on the given robot and player.

      If the robot is powered down, logs a warning and aborts. Supported routines:

      • "energy routine": grants 1 energy to the player
      • "speed routine": moves the robot forward 3 spaces
      • "sandbox routine": lets the robot perform a chosen basic action (default move 1)
      • "weasel routine": executes a default left turn
      • "spam folder": removes one SPAM damage effect (stub logging)
      • default: logs execution of an unknown effect

      Specified by:
      execute in interface RegisterCard
      Specified by:
      execute in class ProgrammingCard
      Parameters:
      robot - the robot performing the special routine
      player - the player controlling the robot
